exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: All women with uterine rupture in Belgium between January 2012 and December 2013
finding: The prevalence of uterine rupture in Belgium was 3.6 per 10,000 deliveries overall, with a significantly higher rate in women with a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: Uterine rupture occurred during TOLAC in 81.4% of cases, with high rates of augmented (38.5%) and induced (29.8%) labor.
